visual.issue: An October 25, 2026 buyer can't start on day one. No page covers Oct 19-25. Start here step 4, listing 'How to start' step 3 and photo 4 cover only 2027 and 'November or December 2026', so 'tap today's date' has no target. Head start Week 1 (Oct 26-Nov 1) shows Mon 26-Sat 31 greyed at 40% opacity and unlinked, and the same days are grey, unlinked cells on the November month page. The first page with Today's top 3 is Sun Nov 1, a week later. This contradicts 'begin this week' (description) and 'Start this week, not January' (photo 9) for the launch-window buyer. Fix: un-grey Oct 26-31 (ideally give them day pages) and add an 'In October? Start on the Oct 26 week' line to Start here and the listing.

visual.issue: On all 72 head-start pages no month tab is active, and NOV/DEC jump to November/December 2027. Contents 'Months' and the Restart 'Jump back in' grid list 2027 only. A Nov/Dec 2026 user tapping the NOV tab, the Contents month or the Restart month lands a year off. The only correct route is the small 'Head start: Nov 2026 · Dec 2026' links or Year > Head start, which is 3 taps, not the promised 2.

Photos 5 and 7 shrink 4 and 3 pages into small thumbnails whose text can't be read at listing size. They leave big empty bands: about 18% top and 15% bottom on photo 5, and the bottom third of photo 7. Photo 5 promises navigation ('tap any date, arrows') but shows no callouts, arrows or highlighted tabs or crumb.
The 'The top bar, on every page' table on Start here gives every item a description except HOME, which is blank and looks like missing text. This also shows in photos 3 and 4.

Head-start months don't match 2027. They have a 'Goals' box instead of 'One goal this month', no habit tracker and no energy-map rows, so a new buyer's first two months have no habit or energy tracking. Photo 8 still says 'A habit tracker for every month'.
Photo 9 says the head start is 'Month and week pages', while photo 10 and the description say it includes day pages (61). The photos contradict each other and photo 9 undersells.

Order and navigation quirks at boundaries: (1) Head-start Week 9 has no next arrow to Week 1 ('Continue' goes to the January month page) and Week 1 has no back arrow. (2) Dec 28-31 2026 day pages sit before January/Week 1 in swipe order, and the December 2026 month page comes after Dec 1-6. (3) Aug 30-31 come after the September month and habit pages, and crumbs disagree: Aug 30 says 'August / Week 36', Week 36 says 'September'. Mar 29-31 and Week 14 behave the same way.

Week numbers are one higher than ISO all year: Week 1 is Dec 28-Jan 3, so 2027 has 53 weeks, while ISO week 1 is Jan 4-10. A buyer (e.g. in March 2027) comparing with a work or phone calendar sees mismatched week numbers.
